about: The denoiser arc's round 47 network (pre-registration sections 116 and 118): the kernel-predicting network 16 channels wide, trained on round 11's 96 scenes of family R and 96 of family C, seed 1, as render/denoiseDevice.mjs decodes it. Trained on R and C only; on them, 1.117 x the shipped network's error on R and 1.297 x on C.
